title: G!theimagineers

attrs.name: prose neutral upper
attrs.text:
Imagination leads to action.
Ideas move between people and disciplines.
Science, technology and culture share a space.
New perspectives ask us to look again.
The collective gives a project its direction.
Experimentation opens another possibility.
A clear frame allows differences to meet.
Progress takes shape through shared work.

attrs.text:
Ideas take shape through people.
Different skills find common ground.

Each question opens a perspective.
Each perspective changes the frame.
Change asks for collective attention.
The work keeps moving forward.
Together, another view becomes clear.
